title: A CT-Based Clinical, Radiological and Radiomic Machine Learning Model for Predicting Malignancy of Solid Renal Tumors (UroCCR-75).
summary: A CT radiomics model classified solid renal-tumor malignancy in a clinical cohort with reported cross-validation metrics. AI role: Clinical, radiomic and machine-learning classification models. The article appeared in Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland).
ai_technology: Clinical, radiomic and machine-learning classification models
